inventory.news_view:
SELECT id AS article_id,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('surface_text', ac.surface_text, 'canonical_text', c.canonical_text, 'auditability_state', ac.auditability_state, 'auditability_note', ac.auditability_note, 'evidence_source_field', ac.evidence_source_field, 'evidence_excerpt', ac.evidence_excerpt, 'evidence_records', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('evidence_url', cel.evidence_url, 'evidence_type', cel.evidence_type) ORDER BY cel.evidence_type, cel.evidence_url) AS jsonb_agg
                   FROM claim_evidence_links cel
                  WHERE cel.claim_id = c.id AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                           FROM mip_private.reader_claim_surfaces rs
                          WHERE rs.claim_id = c.id AND rs.article_id = cel.linked_from_article_id))), '[]'::jsonb)) ORDER BY ac.id) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM article_claims ac
             JOIN claims c ON c.id = ac.claim_id
          WHERE ac.article_id = a.id AND ac.is_current = true AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM mip_private.reader_claim_surfaces rs
                  WHERE rs.id = ac.id))), '[]'::jsonb) AS reviewed_claims
   FROM articles a
  WHERE reader_state = 'eligible'::text AND source_status = 'active'::text;
